subject: Build Lua by default with make test (#3190)
reason: The change only edits src/Makefile: it factors the 'all' target's prerequisites into a variable and makes 'make test' build the same full prerequisite set (including the Lua/TLS/RDMA modules) before running the test suite. It alters what gets compiled before tests, not any runtime behaviour of valkey-server, the tools, replication, persistence or any command, so no fuzzer scenario can reach it and none is needed.
